name: Boardgammon
summary: Boardgammon is a cross-platform backgammon game with rated online matches, private games with friends, optional voice chat and computer opponents at four difficulty levels. Online dice use a verifiable commit-reveal system, and the game includes doubling cube rules, pass-and-play, interactive lessons and daily puzzles. Post-game analysis shows performance rating, equity loss, cube decisions and luck, with move-by-move replay. Players can choose from themed boards and play on iPhone, iPad, Android or in a web browser.
